title: Chapter 1043
text:
Esper Ability — Copy

This was EsGod's core ability, but it had appeared on Evans' body.

Han Xiao's first reaction was to suspect that Evans had something to do with EsGod, and a two-million-word romance instantly popped up in his mind. However, after thinking about the plot in his previous life, he dismissed this thought.

The possibility of it being a coincidence was higher. In the universe, there were many Espers who had awakened the same ability. Fire, water, force fields, these abilities were all common. It was not impossible for another Esper who could absorb Esper Abilities to appear.

However, such a coincidence still gave Han Xiao a sense of deja vu. EsGod had not been locked in the Spacetime Amber for many years, and a new generation of 'EsGod' had appeared in the outside world … Could this be a cycle, and there had to be a Meow King?

"I didn't expect to meet a new 'EsGod'."

Han Xiao was secretly surprised.

With [Esper Ability — Copy], he would definitely walk the path of absorbing other people's Esper Abilities. Evans' talent had been suppressed, but now he had no choice but to start stealing other people's talents. This was too dramatic in his eyes.

Obviously, without a firm belief, the growth of this Esper Ability could easily cause the owner to fall.

Evans, on the other hand, had experienced decades of mortal life and tasted the bitterness of the lowest level. Perhaps he would not be as aggressive as EsGod … but it was also possible that he had hidden resentment in his heart and had suppressed it for a long time before erupting. This was hard to say.

"He's a double-edged sword. If he can be used by me, he'll be a force with extraordinary potential. I have to try my best to guide him to stand on my side. Now that I've done him a favor, his loyalty should be very high. However, if he shows signs of falling one day, I can only kill him to prevent a second EsGod from appearing."

Han Xiao pondered.

Although [Esper Ability — Copy] was strong, what was terrifying was EsGod himself, not this Esper Ability.

In EsGod's hands, all the absorbed Esper Abilities could unleash the power of a Beyond Grade A Super. However, without strength as a foundation, it would be futile no matter how many Esper Abilities he absorbed … He was as ferocious as a tiger, but his damage was 250. No matter how flashy his methods were, he would still be defeated.

Absorbing Esper Abilities was to increase one's combat ability. It was counted as an ability and would not quickly increase one's level and attributes. Therefore, if Evans wanted to increase his Grade, there was no shortcut. He had to train slowly like other Espers. Even if he had talent like [Top Grade Esper Ability Affinity Physique], he would not be able to reach the sky in a single step.

Now that Evans had just awakened, his ability was still extremely weak, only around Grade E or so. Although his template was the overpowered EsGod, how long had EsGod lived? How much combat experience had he accumulated? God knew how long it would take for Evans to reach the Beyond Grade A level.

Because this Esper Ability was too rare, Han Xiao wanted to help him plan his growth path so that it would not be wasted.

The example of EsGod had already shown the limitations of [Esper Ability — Copy]. If he absorbed too many Esper Abilities, there would be a risk of his genetic chain collapsing.

. and Esper Esper Esper ability. and Esper Ability Ability Physique. Esper Ability ability ability Ability ability affinity Ability ability Esper Ability and Esper Esper Esper Ability ability ability ability ability at low Grade Esesper ability ability ability ability ability ability was.

However, due to Evans' Esper Ability Affinity Physique, the number of Esper Abilities he could absorb should be higher than EsGod's.

Furthermore, [Esper Ability — Copy] did not necessarily succeed in absorbing Esper Abilities but had to go through a trial. EsGod had basically absorbed Esper Ability Users whose Grade was lower than his own before using his own strength to unleash the power of a Beyond Grade A Esper. Therefore, it went very smoothly.

In Han Xiao's memories, there was a friend called Jiu Mozhi who used Small Formless Method to activate Baldy's seventy-two ultimate techniques. His combat style was quite similar to EsGod's.

However, the success rate of absorbing the Esper Abilities of someone of the same Grade or even higher would be very low.

Therefore, if Evans wanted to absorb Esper Abilities of someone of a higher Grade, there would be very harsh conditions. For example, the target would be on the brink of death, with extremely low Stamina, Energy, and Health, or the target would be captured. In short, only when the target was of a higher Grade and could not resist would there be a chance of success.

"EsGod has been collecting Esper Abilities for so many years, and his main Esper Ability is very powerful. It's a pity that Evans can't absorb Esper Abilities through the Spacetime Amber. If I open the seal, EsGod will run away. It's only been a few decades, and his consciousness won't die so easily. To be safe, I should lock him up for at least five hundred years."

The amber isolated all energy, and the outside world could not observe EsGod's condition. He could not take the risk of letting EsGod go and open the seal.

Han Xiao put away this thought and thought about Evans' growth path. Very soon, he had an idea.

"Evans isn't suitable for EsGod's path. He should take the path of absorbing Esper Abilities and live a happy life."

EsGod was powerful, but he had absorbed too many Esper Abilities, so his genetic chain was on the verge of collapse. Ninety-nine percent of the Esper Abilities were not used by EsGod in battle.

Although the army had a super healer like Aurora, Han Xiao did not want her to have too much contact with Evans. At most, he would give him some Life Potions.

The reason EsGod absorbed so many Esper Abilities was partly because of his obsession. He wanted to fuse with the Super High Risk Esper Abilities on his own, allowing himself to transform and break through the peak Beyond Grade A limit, becoming a brand new 'creature'.

On the other hand, part of EsGod's obsession probably came from his experiences. Han Xiao had seen EsGod's information before. When he was weak, EsGod had always been alone and could only rely on himself. He only believed in himself, so he wanted to become 'omnipotent' and never need a partner.

Evans did not need to do that, so he did not need to absorb Esper Abilities at all. Choosing only useful and powerful Esper Abilities might be a more correct path.

Seeing Black Star's back facing him and not speaking for a long time, Evans became more and more confused.

He could not help but ask, "Your Excellency Black Star, what exactly am I …"

Han Xiao came back to his senses, turned around, and patted Evans on the shoulder. "Your ability is to absorb the Esper Abilities of others. This is an ability with a lot of potential …"

He explained it once, and Evans finally understood his own ability. But then, he frowned.

"I don't really like this Esper Ability …"

Evans had a conflicted expression. His talent had been suppressed for decades, so he could empathize with this feeling. From the bottom of his heart, he did not like this Esper Ability that stole the talents of others.

Hearing this, Han Xiaoxin could not help but roll his eyes.

Do you think you're buying cabbages at the market? You're still being picky.

After coughing, Han Technician changed his tone and said in a friendly tone, "Don't worry.

Since you're my person now, I'll naturally guide your growth. You don't have to worry, I won't allow you to absorb people casually, so don't be troubled. No one is forcing you to walk the path of crime.

However, at the same time, I hope that you can resist the temptation yourself. Don't think about turning other people's Esper Abilities into your own just because they're good. You're only strong when you're strong. Don't be impatient and walk the wrong path.

EsGod is a good example. He walked the path of depravity, did evil everywhere, and made countless enemies. In the end, he was still locked up in prison by us and lost his freedom. Therefore, don't learn from him in this aspect. Be as low-key as me, understand? "

Hearing Black Star's warning, Evans nodded.

He had also heard of the infamous EsGod. Although he had the same ability, he was not the same kind of person. He secretly warned himself to stay true to himself and not become depraved like EsGod.

After giving some instructions, Han Xiao had some mechanical soldiers escort Evans away.

Now that he was the only one left in the room, he stroked his chin and muttered to himself, "This ability is worth training.

"This guy's ability is worth nurturing. As long as he doesn't take a narrow path, he will definitely become a strong person in time. As for how to help him obtain his ability … Heh, for me, this is actually the easiest part."

Han Xiao chuckled.

In his previous life, EsGod had already tried to absorb the Esper Abilities of players, so Han Xiao knew very well what the result would be …

It was actually feasible!

Although players could revive, their bodies were physical. Other than having strange restrictions and turning into light after dying, they would also be injured and bleed in normal battles, which would be reflected in all kinds of negative statuses.

In Version 1.0, there were even organizations that tried to dissect players. Although due to the limit of health, the players would be boiled into soup … cough, turned into light at the beginning of the dissection, the blood collected would be no different from that of a normal species.

If an Esper player was absorbed by EsGod, they would also lose their Esper Ability and enter the [Ability Freeze] state. All abilities related to Esper Abilities would be grayed out. This state was constant, and no ability could remove it. It was just like when an NPC had his Esper Ability taken away …

However!

When this player died and revived, his status would be refreshed, and his Esper Ability would be recovered!

This involved the mechanism of [Esper Ability — Copy]. The process of the ability taking effect could be summarized as: Seize, Analyze, Genetic Chain Construct, Solidify, and Store.

After seizing an Esper Ability, [Esper Ability — Copy] would break it down, analyze it, and finally store this ability in the body of the owner in the form of a genetic chain. The genetic chain was a special substance produced by [Esper Ability — Copy], which was a substance produced by the owner and would not disappear with the disappearance of the player.

Therefore, in his previous life, there were players who sold themselves as sacrifices to EsGod for money. This was something that had never happened before, and the three Universal Civilizations had no choice but to come up with a special policy, stating that if the Immortals took the initiative to provide EsGod with Esper Abilities, they would be treated as wanted criminals and kicked out of the Order Faction. Of course, the players' operation was very complicated, and this policy was rarely used.

However, EsGod was not a philanthropist. Due to the burden on his genetic chain, he would only give out abilities that he was interested in. Otherwise, even if the players offered themselves as sacrifices, he would not want them …

In fact, the actions of the players even led to a hilarious misunderstanding. At first, EsGod thought that this was a scheme of the three Universal Civilizations, specifically sending people to deliver their heads to him so that his genetic chain would collapse. After killing quite a few players, he realized that these people were truly there to deliver cannons … cough cough, Esper abilities.

At that time, even EsGod was shocked and said a famous line to the players, "If I had met you guys earlier, I might have been a good person."

Thinking about it, Han Xiao could not help but grin.

"Therefore, I don't even have to do it myself to obtain Esper Abilities. As long as I issue a mission to the Esper players and give them enough rewards, people will take the initiative to come to me …"

This way, the tens of millions of Esper players would be a huge material library!

Furthermore, no one would die. It was legal!

Although he had determined the development path for Evans, with so many materials, it meant that he could slowly choose and find complementary Esper Abilities to form various tactics and achieve the most perfect combination!

Thinking of this, Han Xiao was completely excited. At this moment, a new plan was born in his mind.

"Philip!"

"Yes, hum …"

"Draft a new plan. The content is to record the various abilities of all the Esper Immortals under the army and simulate various tactical combinations based on the effects of the Esper Abilities. A combination should have at least two Esper Abilities and at most ten Esper Abilities for the time being. Put this plan in the highest confidential file. Also, don't mention Evans' existence."

"Okay, hum … This will take up a little of my computing power. What's the name of this plan?"

"No need for a name. Just a number will do."

Han Xiao thought of a name like 'EsGod Cultivation Plan', but after thinking about it, he gave up.

Although it was basically impossible for his own database to be breached, Han Xiao still chose to keep a low profile, which was consistent with his personality.

He had already made up his mind that before Evans grew up, he had to hide him as a secret weapon.

"Speaking of which, I have the Evolution Cube and the Spacetime Amber in my hands, and the army has Hella and Aurora. If I tell others that I plan to create a second generation EsGod … Tsk, I'm afraid all the enemies will join forces to snatch my things."

Thinking of that scene, Han Xiao could not help but tremble. He still knew what was going on.

He took a while to digest his emotions before returning to the work he had just done. He continued to build more than half of the King mechanical suit.
